# Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. State whether this changes a proposal, an accepted decision, or implemented behavior.

## Validation

List the commands or evidence used to check the change. Include relevant failure cases.

## Review notes

State remaining limitations, compatibility effects, and any decisions needing maintainer acceptance.

- [ ] Related docs, examples, and roadmap entries agree.
- [ ] Proposed features and measured results are clearly distinguished.
- [ ] Local checks pass.
- [ ] No credentials or private data are included.
